AI Text Generation

BoobaStudio's AI Text Generation feature adds an AI-powered toolbar to Foundry VTT's journal editor, letting you generate, expand, and refine text content directly inside your journals and item descriptions.

Overview

When you open any journal entry or item sheet in edit mode, the BoobaStudio toolbar appears in the ProseMirror text editor. You can highlight text and use AI to rewrite it, or place your cursor and generate new content from a prompt.

How It Works

  • Open a Journal or Item in edit mode
  • Use the BoobaStudio Toolbar buttons or the right-click context menu
  • Enter a Prompt describing what you want
  • AI Generates Text directly into the editor
  • Edit and Refine the result as needed

Features

Generate Text

Click the BoobaStudio icon in the editor toolbar and enter a prompt. The AI will generate text and insert it at your cursor position.

  • Write NPC backstories, item descriptions, location lore
  • Generate quest hooks, rumors, and world-building content
  • Create stat blocks descriptions and flavor text

Expand Text

Select existing text and ask the AI to expand it. Useful for turning brief notes into full paragraphs.

Rewrite Text

Highlight a passage and have the AI rewrite it in a different style—more dramatic, more concise, in-character, or in a different language.

Continue Writing

Place your cursor at the end of existing text and let the AI continue the narrative in the same style and tone.

How to Access

From the Editor Toolbar

  • Open any journal entry or item description in edit mode
  • Look for the BoobaStudio icon in the ProseMirror toolbar
  • Click it to open the AI text prompt

From the Context Menu

  • Select text in the editor
  • Right-click to open the context menu
  • Choose a BoobaStudio AI option (rewrite, expand, etc.)

From the Welcome Screen

  • Open the BoobaStudio welcome screen
  • Click the AI Text card in the features grid
  • A demo journal will be created for you to try

Tips

  • Be specific in prompts — "Write a tavern description with a mysterious atmosphere" works better than "Write something"
  • Use system context — BoobaStudio knows your game system and adapts its writing style
  • Iterate — Generate text, then select parts to rewrite or expand further
  • Undo works — If you don't like a result, use Ctrl+Z to undo the AI insertion
  • Requires an active A configured provider or a configured client-only API key

Requirements

  • BoobaStudio module installed and configured
  • A journal entry or item sheet open in edit mode
  • A configured provider (Module Settings → BoobaStudio)
